# The tests whose claim is about time (ADR-0122): a plugin host answering a
# block within its deadline, a sender keeping its spacing, a disk thread
# reading ahead of real-time playback. On a shared runner with three cores
# no such claim holds every time, whatever the code does, so CI does not
# gate on them (.github/scripts/ci-test.sh, part `timing`):
#
#   - they run after the gated tests, alone, one test at a time, with up to
#     two retries (profile `timing` in .config/nextest.toml), and
#   - a failure is a warning on the run ("Real-time test failed"), not a red
#     job. Look at one when it shows: three misses in a row on a quiet
#     runner is a finding.
#
# Everything else gates, so only a test whose claim is about time belongs
# here. A test that also checks what the code decides (a value, a state, a
# message) should have that part in a target of its own, off this list.
#
# One entry per line. Locally these tests are ordinary tests: `cargo test`
# runs them with everything else.
#
#   <package>::<test target>   a whole integration test (crates/<package>/tests)
#   lumen-app <test name>      the unit tests of lumen-app whose path contains
#                              the name (only lumen-app's are supported)
#
# A test file that reads the wall clock and is neither listed here nor known
# to be harmless fails crates/lumen-app/tests/timing_tests.rs. The E2E suite
# is not listed: its test devices wait for plugin hosts as an offline render
# does, and its waits are lumen_testkit's hang guards.

lumen-audio::supervisor
lumen-engine::hosted
lumen-engine::hosted_effects
lumen-hosting::editor
lumen-hosting::hosting
lumen-hosting::offline
lumen-hosting::parameters
lumen-hosting::rt
lumen-hosting::soak
lumen-app midi::out::sender_tests
# The disk soak plays 64 streamed tracks in real time. Beside the rest of
# the tests on a three-core macOS runner it missed a third of its blocks
# and the starved disk thread read late (2026-11-06, PR #92); alone, and
# here under full load, it reads nothing late (ADR-0109).
lumen-app disk::soak::sixty_four_streamed_tracks_play_with_loops_and_locates_and_none_is_late
